title: Scourge Talent Balance
doc: Slice toggle. Off: Slices.VerdictForOverlay skips every file below before
it is opened, so none of its rows reach RulePlan. These files are loaded
by the row-edit engine, so they also have no effect while [Slices]
ModelRules is off (ModelRules.Init returns before Overlays.Load).
Files this toggle gates:
EffectModel.sc.csv
JobNodeModel.sc.csv
TalentModel.sc.csv
Talent balance pack for Scourge: JobId 15, JobName "Scourge" in JobModel.
The pairing was measured by joining the pack's JobNodeIds (and TalentIds,
through JobNodeModel.NodeTalent1Id) to sheets/raw/JobNodeModel.csv and
JobModel.csv [measured].
Each file is a direct overlay: the part of the filename before the first
dot names the game table, and "sc" is the pack's filename tag.
The title uses the game's JobName. The subsystem name, cfg key
(TalentsSawbones) and filenames keep the older name "Sawbones" / tag "sc";
renaming them would change the cfg key and the overlay filenames.
Do not read the class off an id's leading digits: this pack's TalentIds
and JobNodeIds begin 16, and JobId 16 is "Attack Hund". The owning
JobId is 15, Scourge. Only the join settles it [measured].
uiDoc: Turn this off and the mod skips this page's files, so nothing on this page is applied.
